title: HR and training
summary: HR records, leave, checklists, training, appraisals and recognition are now in the intranet for the people who need them, with clear access controls.

added: HR records you and your manager can open, with access limited to HR and the right roles.
DBS and right-to-work checks with expiry reminders for HR.
Leave balances and requests, with approved leave blocking rota clashes.
Onboarding and offboarding checklists for new starters and leavers.
Required training courses with LMS links, and an overdue list for HR.
Appraisal cycles, objectives and dual sign-off for member and manager.
Recognition: thank a colleague with a message on their profile, and optionally post it to the updates feed.
security: A published DPIA covers how HR records are held and who can see them.
Sensitive HR screens are audited when opened.

internal_notes: Also shipped preview-gate npm ci / Vite readiness (#270) and empty public/run.sh preflight (#276). Parents #51 and #54 were split into #326/#327 and #328/#329.
